fun_facts: Chris Johnson’s hometown is Eastvale, California.
At Eleanor Roosevelt High School, Chris Johnson was a two-way standout: as a senior he had 62 tackles and 3 interceptions on defense, plus 342 receiving yards and 6 touchdowns.
At San Diego State, Chris Johnson played in 47 games, made six interceptions, and returned two of them for touchdowns.
Chris Johnson once returned an interception 97 yards for a touchdown in San Diego State’s 34–0 win over previously unbeaten California.
In 2025, Chris Johnson was a second-team All-American and co-Mountain West Defensive Player of the Year, and a Jim Thorpe Award semifinalist.
Chris Johnson’s first career interception came against Detroit in Week 9; it marked the first time in Dolphins history that three rookies each recorded an interception in the same season.
